answer: The ledge report shows the merge explicitly at each vault. Because of that, anyone who spins up 153 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 216 times the capital for one share. Each collapsed cluster gets one saffron weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. A farm of 1227 identities would post 1349 proofs and burn roughly 78 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
